summary: QTREX Quantum Ltd. furnished a Form -6K (US equivalent: current report) disclosing an October 5, 2026 Nasdaq Listing Qualifications notice that its ordinary shares closed below the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive business days from August 20 through October 1, 2026, under Rule 5550(a)(2). No immediate effect on listing; shares trade as QTEX on the Nasdaq Capital Market. The company has until April 3, 2027 (180 calendar days) to regain compliance, requiring a $1.00 close for 10 consecutive business days; shares have already closed above $1.00 for six straight sessions, October 2 through October 9. This is a routine deficiency notice, not a delisting, and requires no board action or adviser. Watch for written confirmation of compliance or a reverse-split risk if the bid slips again.
